affected_component: Draft self-check with bounded self-repair (intake control plane)
invariant: Machine-drafted workspace controls (fixture builder, blueprints, reference implementation, independent verifier) must be proven mutually consistent by the Harness itself before a human reviews them and before any freeze: the existing candidate-generation ruler plus a verifier discrimination probe run automatically after drafting; a public failure is routed to the one control it implicates and repaired within a bound of two rounds through the fail-closed control-repair transaction with rollback; the resulting report binds the exact proven bytes and readiness blocks freezing (never human review) on MISSING, STALE or FAILED. Verifier repair may add recomputation but never weaken checks; Harness/environment failures never reach a model.
